description: PROP-AUTH-020 claims 'process exits non-zero when any required env var is missing' (REQ-AUTH-011). However, the tests at auth-flow.test.ts:316-365 do NOT test process exit behavior. They call validateRequiredEnvVars() directly and assert result.ok === false. This is identical to what PROP-AUTH-034 already tests in pure-core.test.ts:569-635. REQ-AUTH-011 states: 'SHALL exit with a non-zero code if any validation fails'. The verification architecture (verification-architecture.md:73) specifies: 'Integration test: spawn process with missing vars'. No test spawns a process and checks the exit code. PROP-AUTH-020 is therefore a duplicate of PROP-AUTH-034, not an integration-level process exit test.
